description: Classification of every leaf of the BuilderGate server configuration schema. Pinned against the Zod schema by server/src/schemas/settingsInventory.test.ts, which derives the leaf set at run time via listConfigSchemaLeafPaths.
classificationPrecedenceNote: A leaf can satisfy more than one description; exactly one classification is recorded, chosen by this precedence. inert wins first because a leaf with no consumer cannot meaningfully be anything else. reserved wins next so that the keys RuntimeConfigStore names in RESERVED_WAVE6_SETTING_KEYS keep the classification that table already assigns them. safety-only then captures leaves whose role is to bound or deny, including some that are editable; editableInSettings records that overlap rather than hiding it.
consumerDiscovery: Consumers were located by searching the leaf name across server/src, frontend/src, tools and server/tools, excluding the schema, the generated types, the config template, the Settings facade plumbing and test files, then recording the nearest enclosing declaration at the first match in each module. At most two consumers are recorded per leaf. This is a LOCATOR, not an assertion: the module is where the key is genuinely referenced, but the symbol is the nearest preceding declaration and is not guaranteed to be the exact function that reads the value. Treat it as 'start reading here'. The authoritative check on whether a leaf still has a consumer at all is a fresh search of the shipped surface; the pinning test enforces coverage and classification, not symbol precision. resourceLimits.telemetry.recentEventLimit is the one leaf whose only consumer is inside RuntimeConfigStore itself, where it sets the telemetry ring capacity, so it is recorded explicitly.
